common_envelope: Existing executable04/08/12: ownership conditional tenant, canonical actor, correlation/causation, unique event ID; classification confidential; no source bodies/credentials
audit_change_policy: Canonical AuditEvent actor columns and typed closed payloads preserve review/decision authority; no free IDs as business relation substitutes
transaction: For the new domain-event operations in events[]: mutation + required AuditEvent + OutboxEvent + IdempotencyRecord atomically commit. Existing applicability operations follow applicability_context_binding.transaction; no blanket outbox requirement on create.

applicability_context_binding.storage: ops_audit.audit_events.before_payload/after_payload.applicability_context_v1; additive namespaced profile alongside preserved existing payload fields

operations.before: No aggregate before create; before_payload context profile absent
operations.after: Persisted draft and exact nullable context snapshot
Exact submitted aggregate/context, same pinned KnowledgeVersion
Exact approved aggregate/context, same pinned KnowledgeVersion

applicability_context_binding.authority: Canonical AuditEvent aggregate_type=RequirementApplicability, aggregate_id=exact row ID, ownership_class=TENANT_OWNED and authenticated tenant; actor_user_identity_id is the authorized actual human, actor_service_principal_id NULL, command_code exact operation. Actor authority, existing permission/scope/SoD and Knowledge published-review authority are revalidated in the same transaction; context is input, never legal authority.
applicability_context_binding.version_integrity: Profile snapshots exact knowledge_version_id + knowledge_item_id + version_number + content_hash and context Subject from typed context link under locks. FK matches authenticated tenant; scope_subject_id matches context Subject, or tenant-wide organization context. Hash verifies immutable body/link manifest; no latest-version lookup or text copy.
applicability_context_binding.null_history: New command with no context records context=null. Historical absence of the profile means not recorded, never invented context or backfill. Existing v1 event codes and payload fields retain meaning; no new event code/version or second audit stream.
applicability_context_binding.transaction: Mutation, single existing material AuditEvent and IdempotencyRecord atomically commit. Submit/approve retain their existing domain events/outbox. Create retains NONE and has no newly required outbox. Audit failure rolls back. Replay reauthorizes, checks original request fingerprint, returns original persisted result and creates no duplicate material audit/event.
applicability_context_binding.concurrency: Existing expected_version/row_version CAS for submit/approve remains. Creation uses its existing idempotency/transaction contract; no invented If-Match on create. Locks freeze referenced context; submitted/approved context is immutable.
applicability_context_binding.correlation: Canonical correlation_id/request/causation, server occurred_at and outcome use executable04/08/12. No actor supplied by body, no protected text/secrets.
applicability_context_binding.no_retroactivity: Changing or superseding Knowledge never changes a prior decision/snapshot. Any revised decision is a new governed applicability version; prior NULLs and audit records remain immutable.
